summary: Iteration 18 - full backend + frontend verification of the new automatic CRM backup vault + monthly cron feature. Backend: 15 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration18_backup_vault.py covering (a) role gating: anon 401, salesman 403 on GET/POST/DELETE and download; (b) admin list returns metadata-only records (filename starts with dbg-signs-crm-backup-, content_type application/json, source manual|monthly, collection_count/document_count > 0, storage_path present, no raw `collections`/`content` payload); (c) admin manual /settings/backup-vault/run then GET /{id}/download returns valid application/json, content-disposition attachment, parses via bson.json_util (Extended JSON), payload.format == 'dbg-signs-crm-backup', version 1, contains core collections users/settings/customers, and no system.* collections leaked; (d) soft remove: wrong password rejected (400/401/403), correct password 200 hides record from list and download returns 404; (e) cron auth: /api/cron/monthly-crm-backup with missing bearer -> 401, wrong bearer -> 401, correct bearer -> 200 accepted with echoed run_id; (f) cron idempotency: direct invocation of server._run_monthly_crm_backup(run_id) reaches status 'complete' with backup_id linking a crm_backups doc (source=monthly), re-invocation with same run_id inserts no duplicate cron_run and no duplicate backup. All 15 tests pass in 19.5s. Frontend (admin sales@dbgsigns.com): Settings vault card renders on mobile 390px with no horizontal overflow (doc scrollWidth=390 vs client 390; vault card scrollWidth 324 vs client 324), Run/Download/Remove buttons render, five retained backup rows render on entry, existing Download backup + Restore backup controls still present. Mobile hamburger opens the drawer (data-testid=open-mobile-navigation-btn -> mobile-navigation-drawer), close button and backdrop click both dismiss the drawer. Manual 'Run backup now' on desktop successfully inserts a new row (before 5 -> after 6) with a success toast 'Backup saved · dbg-signs-crm-backup-YYYY-MM-DD-HHMMSS.json'. Salesman (sam@dbgsigns.com) navigation to /settings redirects to /estimates and does not see the vault card (backend endpoints also 403 per pytest). Test-created backups (4) were soft-removed at cleanup, preserving the 2 real retained backups (one manual 165818 + one monthly 165819) as instructed. No real restore was executed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 6213 lines - well beyond the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into feature modules (auth, invoices, backup, cron, etc.) for maintainability. Not a blocker for this feature.

_create_crm_vault_backup returns clean(record) but on the manual /run endpoint the returned dict includes the internal `storage_path` field. It is not a public URL and cannot be used without admin auth to download, but exposing internal storage paths to the client is unnecessary. Consider projecting only display fields (id, filename, size, source, collection_count, document_count, created_at, created_by) in list + run responses.

_run_monthly_crm_backup guards against duplicate run_id via db.cron_runs.find_one before inserting, but the insert is not atomic with the check under concurrent invocations. Low risk here because cron is a single scheduler, but consider a unique index on cron_runs.run_id to make idempotency race-safe (also applies to the two other cron jobs).
seed_data_creation: Created 4 transient CRM vault backups during testing (3 manual via test fixtures + 1 monthly via cron idempotency direct invocation). All 4 were soft-removed at end of run. The 2 pre-existing retained real backups (2026-09-24 16:58 manual + monthly) are untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vault endpoints: GET/POST/DELETE /api/settings/backup-vault[/{id}[/download]]. DELETE requires body {password}. Cron endpoint POST /api/cron/monthly-crm-backup requires Authorization: Bearer <WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET> and honours x-webhook-id header for idempotency. UI testids: backup-vault-card, run-vault-backup-btn, backup-vault-list, vault-backup-{id}, vault-backup-name-{id}, download-vault-backup-{id}, remove-vault-backup-{id}, backup-vault-empty. Mobile nav testids: open-mobile-navigation-btn, mobile-navigation-drawer, close-mobile-navigation-btn, close-mobile-navigation-backdrop. Do NOT run POST /api/settings/restore against production data.
